notes: The prompt self-declares an FPS, so Shooter is settled; what it actually asks to build is only the lobby, and the author confirmed the match map comes later. None of Shooter's typical shapes is a lobby — lane-network, rooms-sequence, open-battlefield and range-directed all describe a combat map — so I took space-bounded from the wider catalogue: one clearly bounded single-level space that the whole activity happens inside, which routes P0 and does not commit the build to being indoors or outdoors. No preset applies, because all nine are match modes; taking Team Deathmatch would mean swapping its shape and dropping every one of its options, which the skill says is building from scratch, so preset is none and the options list is empty rather than padded with cover arrays and team bases the lobby has no use for. With no user to ask, I sized it for the author's stated eight players, left the later team-versus-team lane map out of this build entirely, and did not add a match-start exit since the queue it leads to does not exist yet.
